description: System app that classifies URLs, installs/manages web apps, generates .desktop entries

capabilities.expected: JSON output with classification.level, metadata.name, metadata.iconUrl, finalUrl. Exit 0.
level=PWAPP, hasManifest=true, hasServiceWorker=true, name from manifest, icon URL from manifest.
level=WAPP, hasManifest=true, hasServiceWorker=false.
level=WS, hasManifest=false, hasServiceWorker=false, name from <title>.

JSON with appId, name, desktopPath. Files created: ~/.local/share/applications/qapp-example-com.desktop, ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/apps/example-com.json, ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/icons/example-com.png. Exit 0.
JSON with uninstalled field. All 3 files removed (.desktop, .json, icon). Exit 0.
JSON array sorted by name. Each entry has appId, name, level, url. Exit 0.
JSON array with appId, name, hasUpdate, changes[] for each WAPP/PWAPP app. Exit 0.
Prints version string. Exit 0.
Prints usage with all available flags. Exit 0.
ApplicationWindow 640x480 with Install and Manage tabs, header with logo and menu.

capabilities.test: Type invalid URL in input field
capabilities.expected: Classify button disabled for invalid URLs, enabled for valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs.
BusyIndicator shows, status messages update (Fetching page... Parsing...), results panel shows level badge (WS/WAPP/PWAPP), name, icon preview, metadata grid.
WS=gray badge, WAPP=blue badge, PWAPP=green badge.

capabilities.test: After classify, click 'Choose icon...' and select PNG file
capabilities.expected: FileDialog opens (PNG/SVG/ICO filter). Selected icon shows in preview. Install uses custom icon.
BusyIndicator, then success message. .desktop file, metadata JSON, icon file created. App appears in Manage tab.

capabilities.test: Classify URL that is already installed
capabilities.expected: Button text changes to 'Reinstall'. Remove button visible.
Shows 'N installed apps' counter. ListView with each app: level badge, name, URL.
Correct binary launches detached: WS/WAPP -> qapp-ws-wrapper, PWAPP -> qapp-pwa-app. Args: appId url.
App removed from list. All 3 files deleted (.desktop, metadata, icon).

capabilities.test: With WAPP/PWAPP apps installed, observe Manage tab
capabilities.expected: 'Checking for updates...' status. Apps with changes show 'Update' badge and button.
UpdateDialog shows. Runs update.sh. Live status messages stream. Success or error reported.
QAppAboutDialog shows with version, tagline, links.
Opens https://eupl.eu/1.2/en/ in system browser.
Hamburger menu opens.
metadata.name = 'My Site' (when no manifest).

capabilities.test: Classify WAPP with manifest.name = 'App Name' and <title> = 'Different'
capabilities.expected: metadata.name = 'App Name' (manifest wins over title).

capabilities.test: Classify site with /sw.js (no SW hint in HTML)
capabilities.expected: hasServiceWorker=true. Pipeline probes /sw.js, /service-worker.js, /serviceworker.js.

capabilities.test: Classify site with no manifest icon, no HTML icon, no favicon.ico
capabilities.expected: Generated letter icon (data:image/svg+xml with first letter, hashed color).

capabilities.test: Classify URL that redirects (e.g., http -> https, or domain redirect)
capabilities.expected: finalUrl reflects actual URL after all redirects. Classification uses final page.

capabilities.test: Classify site that returns 403/503 to QNetworkAccessManager
capabilities.expected: Falls back to WebFetcher (headless Chromium). Classification still succeeds.

capabilities.test: Classify PWA with display_override, shortcuts, file_handlers, protocol_handlers in manifest
capabilities.expected: All fields present in ClassifyResult: displayOverride[], shortcuts[], mimeTypes[], protocolHandlers[].
appId = 'my-example-com-8080'. Default ports (80/443) omitted.
Contains: Type=Application, Name, Exec=/path/to/wrapper appId url, Icon=/path/to/icon, Terminal=false, StartupNotify=true, Categories=Network;WebBrowser;.
.desktop Exec points to qapp-pwa-app (not qapp-ws-wrapper). metadata.wrapperPath = pwa-app path.

capabilities.test: Install a WS or WAPP site
capabilities.expected: .desktop Exec points to qapp-ws-wrapper. metadata.wrapperPath = ws-wrapper path.

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with shortcuts[] in manifest
capabilities.expected: .desktop file has [Desktop Action] sections for each shortcut.
Valid JSON with: appId, name, url, level, iconPath, desktopPath, wrapperPath, installedAt (ISO 8601). Optional: displayMode, themeColor, backgroundColor, startUrl, scope.

capabilities.test: Install app with web URL icon (not data: URI)
capabilities.expected: Icon downloaded to ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/icons/{appId}.png. On download failure: letter icon generated.
SVG icon decoded and saved to icons/ dir.
